title: 华为手机放言一两年超过苹果：“情怀不能当饭吃”
lineage: Contemporary event coverage including an on-site account and remarks made by Huawei Consumer Business CEO Richard Yu to journalists after the presentation.

passages.locator: Opening photograph caption and event account; discussion of the Kirin 950
passages.note: The reporter dates the Huawei Mate 8 unveiling at the Shanghai World Expo Center to 26 November 2015 and identifies the announced phone’s Kirin 950 in the CEO’s remarks.
